QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` on, they dispatch through function pointers... The static pointer defaults to `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC`. That macro is off in the shipped config (`mbedtls_config.h:4124`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer treats MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as a switch, but says only that MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC (not MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY) is off in the shipped config, so it never states that MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY itself is commented out.
